text.description: The text that should appear for the item.

icon.description: The icon that should appear for the item.  Ex. "database"

iconColor.description: The color of the icon that should appear for the item.  Ex. "lilac"

isExpanded.description: If true, the item should have a button to collapse it.

isCollapsed.description: If true, the item should have a button to expand it.

isDisabled.description: If true, the item should be grayed out.

itemActions.description: The expected item action icon names from left to right.  Ex. ["eye"]

title:
A test type used for verifying a single item in a {@link UiSdlTreeList}.
This is used by {@link LukeTestUiSdlTreeList#checkItems}.
name: LukeTestUiSdlTreeListItem
